name: Lugaid Conmac
text: Lugaid Conmac serves on occasion as the eponym of Connemara, taking the place of the region's usual founder Conmac. Tradition makes him a by-blow of Medb and Fergus mac Roich. Commentators treat him as either an emanation of Lugaid mac Con or a figure confused with that king.
attributes: sometime eponym of Connemara in place of the usual founder Conmac
by-blow of Medb and Fergus mac Róich
emanates from, or is confused with, Lugaid mac Con
